headline: PHP2Shell and Fragnesia chained to root firewalls alongside VMware ESX zero-day; Cisco ASA/FTD VPN zero-day; Oracle EBS exploitation attempts

bullets.text: New: Help Net Security reports China-linked attackers used the VMware ESX zero-day CVE-2026-41709, while PHP2Shell and Fragnesia were chained to root firewalls. PHP2Shell is now covered by seven outlets; earlier reporting said it rooted 25 servers.

Cisco patched CVE-2026-76418, an actively exploited ASA and FTD VPN zero-day used to crash SSL VPN devices, its second firewall VPN zero-day since August. Cisco SD-WAN zero-day exploitation has been tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network.
Exploitation attempts have begun against Oracle E-Business Suite RCE flaw CVE-2026-101767, days after Oracle patched it. Five outlets are tracking Oracle EBS.
Adobe, Veeam and Juniper Networks released patches for critical vulnerabilities; Brotli CVE-2026-111497 and Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 are on CISA's KEV list with a 2026-11-10 due date.

Attackers turned GitHub issues into a supply-chain campaign against 61 public repositories in under an hour. Separately, an attacker tried to exploit Alpine Linux's GitLab via CVSS 10.0 flaw CVE-2026-97229.

Breaches: Belgium's tax agency confirmed a cyberattack and pulled services offline; 2.6 million records stolen from Sony's ISP So-net; hacktivists leaked records on 41,000 DHS staff; iRhythm toll put at 8.2 million.

actions: Finish PHP updates to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 now (KEV due date passed today) and check PHP hosts and firewalls for signs of compromise.
Patch VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 despite its low score (KEV due 2026-11-11), and review ESX audit logging for gaps.
Apply Cisco's fix for ASA/FTD VPN CVE-2026-76418, review VPN logs and crashes, and check SD-WAN against Cisco's advisories.
Confirm Oracle's patch for E-Business Suite CVE-2026-101767 is applied and check EBS logs for exploitation attempts.
Apply your distro's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31; patch Adobe Commerce/Magento and Brotli by 2026-11-10.
Check public GitHub repos for unexpected issues, commits or workflow runs; limit token permissions for issue-triggered workflows.
